title: LoopScript
description: Validates an i-SASE LoopScript (pure YAML). A LoopScript defines the ordered phases, gates, and escalation policies for a SASE execution loop.

schema.description: Schema identifier for the LoopScript artifact type.

phases.description: Ordered list of phases that make up the execution loop.

id.description: Unique identifier for this phase within the loop.

gate.description: Gate condition that must be satisfied before advancing past this phase.

gate-command.description: Shell command for automated gate check. Must exit 0 to pass.

strict.description: If true, gate failure creates CRP

on-uncertainty.description: Action or strategy to apply when uncertainty is detected during this phase.

escalation.description: Escalation policies that govern when and how the loop escalates issues.

uncertainty-threshold.description: Threshold at which uncertainty triggers escalation. Can be a numeric value or a named level.

scope-creep.description: Threshold or policy for detecting and escalating scope creep.

n-version.description: N-version programming configuration for redundant execution of critical phases.

enabled.description: Whether n-version redundant execution is enabled.

count.description: Number of independent versions to execute in parallel.
